          Coxmos
          May 2026
        

        
        
          
            R
          
            package
          
            multi-omics
          
        

        R package for interpretable Cox survival analysis on high-dimensional and multiblock (multi-omics) data, combining classical Cox regression with sparse PLS-based methods.

          MORE
          Jun 2025
        

        
        
          
            R
          
            package
          
            multi-omics
          
        

        R package to model multi-omics regulatory relationships using PLS or regularized regression, identifying candidate regulators for a target omic feature.

          Jun 2025

            Shiny
          
            multi-omics
          
        

        Dockerized Shiny interface for MORE, aimed at users with less experience in R or statistics who want to run its core functionality through a graphical interface.
